turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is your PayLite training coach. We'll do a quick five-question check on the Soundbox. Ready?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: First question. What does the Soundbox cost the merchant?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's a rental of ninety-nine rupees a month, and the first month is free.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Question two. Which payment types does it support?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Only UPI. It doesn't take cards.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question three. What documents does a merchant need to sign up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: PAN, bank account details, and a photo of the shop. GST isn't needed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question four. A merchant says, 'I already have a free QR sticker, why should I pay for a Soundbox?' How do you respond?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'd say, sir, with the sticker you have to check your phone for every payment, and people can show a fake screenshot. The Soundbox announces every payment out loud in your language, so your staff know it's real without looking. And the first month is free, and if you don't like it you can return it in thirty days.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Last one. When does the merchant get the money in their bank account?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Instantly. Settlement is T plus zero.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's the end of the check. Good work, Arjun. You'll get your feedback by message.
